name: com.cupkekgames.assetvaults
description: Keeps large packs out of git without taking them out of the project. Packs live under Assets/Vault, so Unity imports and uses them normally; git ignores them and cloud storage holds them, with a fresh clone downloading as a setup step. Restores .meta GUIDs intact. Storage-agnostic: backends register themselves, so this package installs alone.
